title: Night Prayers for Overthinkers: 3 Lines to Quiet Your Mind
hook: Racing thoughts at night? Pray these 3 short lines.
script: Racing thoughts at night? Pray these 3 short lines. Slow breath in, slow breath out. One: Father, I cast all my cares on You, because You care for me. First Peter 5:7. Two: Jesus, guard my heart and mind with Your peace beyond understanding. Philippians 4:7. Three: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for You alone make me dwell in safety. Psalm 4:8. If your mind starts racing again, repeat lines one through three with your breathing. God is not in a hurry with you. Save this for tonight.

title: Bedtime Prayer Loop for Overthinkers
hook: Overthinking again at bedtime? Try this.
script: Overthinking again at bedtime? Try this. Inhale: Lord, You keep in perfect peace the one whose mind is stayed on You. Isaiah 26:3. Exhale: Shepherd, lead me beside still waters; restore my soul. Psalm 23. Inhale: I come to You weary and burdened; give me rest. Matthew 11:28. Let these lines set the pace for your thoughts. When worries return, return to the words. Peace is not a performance; it’s a Person who is near. Save this and pray it until your shoulders drop.

title: When God Feels Silent at 2 A.M.: 3 Peace Prayers
hook: If God feels silent at 2 a.m., pray this.
script: If God feels silent at 2 a.m., pray this. First: Search me, God, know my anxious thoughts, and gently reorder them. Psalm 139:23. Second: Prince of Peace, speak, Peace, be still, over this stormy mind. Mark 4:39. Third: When I lie down, let my sleep be sweet; I trust You with tomorrow. Proverbs 3:24. Breathe with each line. You don’t have to solve the night to be safe in it. The Shepherd stays awake so you can rest. If your thoughts flare, loop this again and let the truth do the heavy lifting. Save it for later.
